note: Baseline built from primary sources: Metro Vancouver DCC page and the City of Vancouver DCL Bulletin (amended 2026-01-22).
First pass took $39.06/m2 from an industry blog. The City's own DCL Bulletin Table 1 gives $31.25/m2 for the at-or-below 1.2 FSR band. The blog figure was wrong.

First pass treated the residential DCL as one flat rate. It is banded by density: $81.13/m2 at or below 1.2 FSR, $174.67 from 1.2-1.5 FSR, $349.54 above 1.5 FSR. Using the lowest band for an apartment project understated Vancouver DCLs roughly 4x.
TransLink DCC found in Bulletin Appendix E and added to the calculator. Only 2025 and 2026 rates are published.

The $38.54/unit townhouse figure came from a Surrey comparator report and was wrong. Burnaby's own rate table gives townhouse DCC $37,423/unit plus ACC $18,874. Full DCC+ACC schedule loaded, plus Community Benefit Bonus density rates.

Surrey's own site names Bylaw 21174 (May 2024) as current. The 2026 rates are with the Inspector of Municipalities and not in force. Split into separate proposed rows; in-force schedule left unloaded rather than guessed.
Unverified third-hand figures removed rather than carried. These four jurisdictions now show no rate and are flagged for a primary-source pass.

Added Victoria, Courtenay, Nanaimo, Parksville, Langford, Colwood (verified from bylaws) plus Comox and Duncan (flagged unverified - bylaw PDFs blocked). 32 fee rows, per-service calculator path, CRD regional water DCC, and 3 upcoming Island events. Nanaimo Bylaw 7438 (triples the single-family charge Jan 2027) loaded as proposed.
